data.title: A handle on the long bench
data.goal: A handle on the long bench

memoryNodes.cue: The finished repair becomes a benchmark.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 维修成果成为衡量标准。

data.situation:
Behind the stockroom stood a long wooden bench. Eli’s bag was waiting under the lamp. Mina was meticulous about matching the thread, but she let Jay try the new handle himself. He was already capable of making a simple repair; this one needed two stronger rows of stitching. They employed a clamp to keep the handle still. It was indispensable for this awkward angle, so Jay moved it rather than trying to hold everything with one hand. Mina was overseeing the work, not taking it away from him. She wanted to cultivate the habit of checking a repair before packing it. When they finished, she kept a photograph of the stitching as a benchmark for the next bag. Eli’s pockets were still exactly where he liked them. Mina: Check the thread against the fabric before you start.
Jay: Should I use the clamp here?
Mina: Yes. It will keep the handle still.
Jay: And then pull the handle gently to check both rows?
Mina: Exactly. Put the finished bag beside the collection card.

readingBlocks.zh: 库房后面是一张长木工作台，伊莱的包在台灯下等着。米娜挑线十分仔细，但让杰伊自己试做新提手。他已经能完成简单维修，这次需要两排更结实的缝线。他们用夹具固定提手。在这个不方便的角度，夹具必不可少，所以杰伊调整夹具，没有试图用一只手握住所有东西。米娜在监督工作，并没有接手替他做。她想培养他打包前检查维修结果的习惯。完成后，她留下缝线照片，作为下一次修包的衡量标准。伊莱喜欢的口袋仍在原来的位置。

readingBlocks.en:
Mina: Check the thread against the fabric before you start.
Jay: Should I use the clamp here?
Mina: Yes. It will keep the handle still.
Jay: And then pull the handle gently to check both rows?
Mina: Exactly. Put the finished bag beside the collection card.
readingBlocks.zh:
米娜：开始之前，把线和织物放一起核对。
杰伊：这里要用夹具吗？
米娜：要，它能固定提手。
杰伊：然后轻拉提手，检查两排缝线？
米娜：对。完成的包放在取件卡旁。

glossary.note: meticulous about something；不只是做得慢。
glossary.example: Mina was meticulous about matching the thread.

externalEvidence.definition: marked by extreme care in treatment of details

glossary.note: indispensable for something；不等同于只是方便。
glossary.example: The clamp was indispensable for that awkward angle.
glossary.exampleZh: 在那个不方便的角度，夹具必不可少。

externalEvidence.definition: not to be dispensed with; essential

glossary.note: be capable of + 名词或动名词；was capable of making a repair。
glossary.example: Jay was capable of making a simple repair.

glossary.note: overseeing 是监督过程；Overseeing the repair 可作主语，was overseeing 表示当时正在监督。
glossary.example: Overseeing the repair was part of Mina’s work.
glossary.exampleZh: 监督维修是米娜工作的一部分。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.publisher: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary / Oxford University Press
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: verb definition; verb forms list overseeing; responsible-for-overseeing usage

glossary.note: employ something to do something；较正式的 use，与 Q02 雇用人的义不同。
glossary.example: They employed a clamp to hold the handle still.

externalEvidence.definition: put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose

glossary.note: cultivate a habit；原种植义留待植物场景，不因本课计全部义。
glossary.example: Mina wanted to cultivate the habit of checking repairs.
glossary.exampleZh: 米娜想培养检查维修结果的习惯。

glossary.zh: 用来比较或衡量的标准
glossary.note: a benchmark for something；本课不是测量用固定水准点。
glossary.example: The photograph provided a benchmark for the next repair.
glossary.exampleZh: 照片为下一次维修提供衡量标准。

externalEvidence.definition: a standard by which something can be measured or judged
